videoDirection.paletteTypeSource: Project colorset1 tonal palette and Open Sans stack.
videoDirection.alignmentMode: Fixed-frame semantic workbench on a 4-pixel grid with object-bound labels and explicit input-action-result reading paths.

videoDirection.boxInteriorPolicy: Zero internal padding; content is flush to declared bounds and separation uses external gutters.

videoDirection.rhythm: Eight distinct workbenches reveal one input, one causal action, and one visible result; each holds long enough for muted comprehension before the seam handoff.
